environment.description: Application deployed on an EC2 instance in a public subnet with an Application Load Balancer forwarding all /api/* paths to the target group. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0 on the ALB, and port 8080 from the ALB security group on the instance. No WAF is attached to the ALB. The SQLite database contains production user records including API keys in a column not returned by default but accessible via UNION-based injection.

config.network: Public subnet, ALB with HTTPS listener forwarding to target group on port 8080
config.alb_rules: Default action: forward all /api/* to target group, no additional rules
